analyst.text: New Orleans are in turmoil: Dejounte Murray has requested a trade and posted a since-deleted 'sabotage' tweet, Zion Williamson told teammates to look in the mirror, and the Pelicans have lost six straight. Golden State are without Stephen Curry (oblique tear), with Steve Kerr saying 'concern is high'. On morale the angle leans towards the Warriors despite their absences.
